# Coverage gap analysis and recommendation

The module provides the ability to identify components that lack adequate test coverage, analyze the risk associated with those gaps, and generate actionable recommendations (such as what to test or retest) to improve coverage. It differentiates between several types of gaps—uncertainty in coverage due to low confidence, stale tests that predate code changes, tests that may not truly verify invariants (low mutation-kill), and cases where historical bug-fix data shows coverage was ineffective. This supports the broader mission of providing deterministic, explainable test coverage plans for evolving codebases.
